name: Omaraoke
author: igoroh
description: Karaoke overlay: synced lyrics on your wallpaper with an audio-reactive color organ

barWidget.description: Start and stop karaoke from the bar, and pick how the lyrics move, where they sit, and whether the color organ runs

schema.label: Motion
schema.description: How the lyric lines move: a continuous upward crawl, or a line that holds the centre and hands over at the change.

schema.label: Position
schema.description: Where the lyrics sit on screen.

schema.label: Stay Awake
schema.description: Hold off the screensaver and the lock screen for as long as the session is open. Restored on close unless you had Stay Awake on already.

schema.label: Effects
schema.description: The color organ: sparks on the wallpaper that follow the music, in your theme's accent. Off leaves just the lyrics.
